current_prompt.body:
WRITE a Python program that converts Markdown text to HTML without using any external libraries. The program MUST support: - HEADER syntax for levels 1 to 6 using # through ######. - BOLD formatting using **text** and __text__. - ITALIC formatting using *text* and _text_. - INLINE CODE delimited by backticks `code`. - LINKS formatted as [text](url). - UNORDERED LISTS where items start with - or *. - CODE BLOCKS indicated by four-space indentation or fenced with backticks. - PARAGRAPHS that wrap consecutive non-blank lines in

tags. PROVIDE a test suite containing at least 10 distinct Markdown test strings covering all listed features, including nested formatting cases such as bold inside italic, and edge cases like empty headers and links with special characters.

#!/usr/bin/env python3 import re import sys def markdown_to_html(md: str) -> str: lines = md.split('\n') html_blocks = [] i = 0 in_code_block = False code_block_buffer = [] while i < len(lines): line = lines[i] # fenced code block start/end if line.startswith('```'): if in_code_block: html_blocks.append('
' + '\n'.join(code_block_buffer) + '\n
') code_block_buffer = [] in_code_block = False else: in_code_block = True i += 1 continue # indented code block (four spaces) if not in_code_block and line.startswith(' '): # collect consecutive indented lines indented = [] while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith(' '): indented.append(lines[i][4:]) i += 1 html_blocks.append('
' + '\n'.join(indented) + '\n
') continue if in_code_block: code_block_buffer.append(line) i += 1 continue # header header_match = re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s*(.*)$', line) if header_match: level = len(header_match.group(1)) content = header_match.group(2).strip() html_blocks.append(f'' + inline_format(content) + f'') i += 1 continue # unordered list if re.match(r'^\s*[-*]\s+', line): items = [] while i < len(lines) and re.match(r'^\s*[-*]\s+', lines[i]): item = re.sub(r'^\s*[-*]\s+', '', lines[i]) items.append('
  • ' + inline_format(item) + '
    • ') i += 1 html_blocks.append('
      ' + ''.join(items) + '
    ') continue # blank line -> separate paragraphs if line.strip() == '': i += 1 continue # paragraph (collect consecutive non-blank lines) para_lines = [] while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() != '' and not re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s', lines[i]) and not lines[i].startswith('```') and not lines[i].startswith(' '): para_lines.append(lines[i]) i += 1 paragraph = ' '.join(para_lines).strip() html_blocks.append('

    ' + inline_format(paragraph) + '

    ') return '\n'.join(html_blocks) def inline_format(text: str) -> str: # Escape HTML special chars text = (text.replace('&', '&') .replace('<', '<') .replace('>', '>')) # code spans text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+?)`', r'\1', text) # links text = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)', r'\1', text) # bold (both ** and __) text = re.sub(r'(?\1', text) text = re.sub(r'__(.+?)__', r'\1', text) # italic (both * and _) text = re.sub(r'(?\1', text) text = re.sub(r'_([^_]+?)_', r'\1', text) return text if __name__ == '__main__': # simple demo if run directly sample_md = '''# Sample Header\n\nThis is a **bold** and *italic* text with a [link](https://example.com).\n\n- Item 1\n- Item 2\n\n def foo():\n return \"bar\"\n''' print(markdown_to_html(sample_md)) # Test suite import unittest class TestMarkdownToHTML(unittest.TestCase): def assertHTML(self, md, expected): self.assertEqual(markdown_to_html(md).strip(), expected.strip()) def test_headers(self): self.assertHTML('# H1', '

    H1

    ') self.assertHTML('## H2', '

    H2

    ') self.assertHTML('###### H6', '
    H6
    ') self.assertHTML('####### Not a header', '

    ####### Not a header

    ') self.assertHTML('# ', '

    ') def test_bold_italic(self): self.assertHTML('**bold**', '

    bold

    ') self.assertHTML('__bold__', '

    bold

    ') self.assertHTML('*italic*', '

    italic

    ') self.assertHTML('_italic_', '

    italic

    ') self.assertHTML('**bold inside *italic***', '

    bold inside italic

    ') self.assertHTML('*italic inside **bold***', '

    italic inside bold

    ') def test_inline_code(self): self.assertHTML('`code`', '

    code

    ') self.assertHTML('Mix `code` with text', '

    Mix code with text

    ') def test_links(self): self.assertHTML('[example](http://example.com)', '

    example

    ') self.assertHTML('Link with special chars [test](https://example.com/?q=1&b=2)', '

    Link with special chars test

    ') def test_unordered_lists(self): md = '- a\n- b\n* c' expected = '
    • a
    • b
    • c
    ' self.assertHTML(md, expected) def test_code_blocks(self): md_fenced = '```\ncode line 1\ncode line 2\n```' expected_fenced = '
    code line 1\ncode line 2\n
    ' self.assertHTML(md_fenced, expected_fenced) md_indent = ' indented code line 1\n indented code line 2' expected_indent = '
    indented code line 1\nindented code line 2\n
    ' self.assertHTML(md_indent, expected_indent) def test_paragraphs(self): md = 'First line\nSecond line\n\nThird line' expected = '

    First line Second line

    \n

    Third line

    ' self.assertHTML(md, expected) def test_complex(self): md = '''# Header\n\nParagraph with **bold**, *italic*, `code` and a [link](https://example.com).\n\n- List item with **bold**\n- Another *italic* item\n\n def foo():\n return \'bar\''' expected = '''

    Header

    \n

    Paragraph with bold, italic, code and a link.

    \n
    • List item with bold
    • Another italic item
    \n
    def foo():\n    return 'bar'\n
    ''' self.assertHTML(md, expected) if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
